summary: Iteration 64 — Netlify real integration + HostingPanel UI + welcome email on signup. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass (netlify status w/ Sam Thakkar full_name, /integrations/netlify/sites, link→GET persistence, deploy structured response, signup latency <5s + '[welcome] sent to' log line found). Frontend: /dev-os/integrations now shows 4-tile live status grid (github/vercel/netlify/mailgun) with Netlify=Sam Thakkar+live pill; Netlify catalog card shows 'connected · Real token live · link & deploy'; /dev-os/projects/{pid} Plan tab renders HostingPanel with hosting-vercel + hosting-netlify cards; both link/deploy work and picker (hosting-{provider}-picker) opens via Link/Change… and lists items (empty list rendered with friendly empty-state since the real Vercel/Netlify accounts have 0 projects/sites). critical_code_review_comments: HostingPanel.jsx is clean and reusable: identical shape for both providers via prop-injected listEndpoint/idField/payload — good DRY. data-testids are well-formed (hosting-panel, hosting-{provider}, hosting-{provider}-link/deploy/change/picker/pick-{id}/name).
Backend netlify_service surface (verify_token/list_sites/link_site/get_link/trigger_deploy) mirrors the vercel_service shape — call sites are symmetric on the route layer, easy to maintain.

/api/auth/signup correctly uses asyncio.create_task to fire welcome_email.send_welcome — measured signup latency ~1.3s, well under the 5s threshold. The welcome log line 'INFO:teamnest:[welcome] sent to welcome-test-{ts}@example.com · provider=services.mailgun_service' was found after a 2.5s sleep — fire-and-forget plumbed correctly.
(Minor / not blocking) Signup payload schema requires `name` (not `full_name`) — worth aligning with the rest of the codebase that uses `full_name` in user records. Updated test accordingly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (live tiles, catalog, HostingPanel render+picker, regression all verified)
